qualification: Only the original main public requests qualify. Additional diagnostic images never repair qualification.
source_validation: Validate each slot against its frozen installed source and actual compressed bootstrap bytes.
Decode raw wire resources, current transforms and source face order before asset mapping.
Bind document and object instances locally, then map to the fixed asset object key and object-local source triangle.
Validate full directory, retained/excluded order, source geometry, current camera and each producer frame identity.
quality_equal_fields: All target regions, all 514 declared source faces and their support partition.
All six classifications including the exact blocker and unknown reasons.
Actual selected view order, all pixel rows, readability, coverage and complete witness references.
Actual camera specifications and all RGB/depth/asset-owner/source-triangle/patch buffers.
explicit_scope_differences: facts.scene_identity is validated against each actual retained geometry commitment, then represented by the common frozen target geometry in the target-quality comparison.
scope.capture_object_count, occluder_only_object_count and excluded_object_count are validated and reported as acquisition scope facts. Their actual numbers remain in the scope audit.
All retained non-target support rows must be occluder_only with zero supported and unsupported target counts. The target support row is compared, while original full rows remain in the audit.
Current runtime instances and source-bound image references are validated before mapping to asset/view keys. They are not compared as raw fresh-session identifiers.
exclusion_gate: Every excluded object's original frozen geometry and actual directory bound must satisfy the independent two-stage rounding-tree six-view outside proof. Far11 must be excluded in the main input. Target-only excludes zero objects.
scope_reporting: Raw full facts remain pinned. Target semantic equality and differing acquisition scope values are reported separately. No blanket field dropping, hash removal or missing-to-truth filling.
cost_scoring: Quality validation does not authorize a performance pass or rewrite failed/unrun formal slots.
